newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via two-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via two-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday via two-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"I'm loking for a system RP .. and my best guess on the term is two days," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Saporta added, however, the term could vary from an overnight to a nine-day system RP.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International expect the Fed to add reserves via two-day system RPs.
At 1030 EST/1530 GMT, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-5/16 percent, above the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
